name: Word Chip
description: A phrase whose last word sits in a chip and keeps changing, while the text around it slides to make room.

props.name: text
props.description: The fixed text before the chip.

props.name: words
props.description: Words shown in the chip in turn. Screen readers hear the fixed text followed by all of them.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds each word stays. The cycle pauses while the phrase is off screen, and holds the first word under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span. Font, size and colour are inherited. Other span props are passed through.
